name: quad-pcb
description: Micro quadcopter flight controller + frame PCB (tscircuit)

scripts.sch: bun ./build.tsx --sch; tsci export dist/sch.circuit.json -f schematic-svg -o "$PWD/img/schematic.svg" && bun scripts/svg.ts
scripts.fab: mkdir -p fab && tsci export dist/circuit.json -f gerbers -o "$PWD/fab/gerbers.zip" && zip -q -d fab/gerbers.zip bom.csv pick_and_place.csv F_Fab.gbr && cd fab && unzip -q -o gerbers.zip drill-L1-L2.drl && awk '/^G85/{p=p $0; next} NR>1{print p} {p=$0} END{print p}' drill-L1-L2.drl > slots.tmp && mv slots.tmp drill-L1-L2.drl && zip -q gerbers.zip drill-L1-L2.drl && rm drill-L1-L2.drl && cd .. && bun scripts/jlc.ts
scripts.kicad: mkdir -p kicad && tsci export dist/circuit.json -f kicad_pcb -o "$PWD/kicad/quad.kicad_pcb" && tsci export dist/sch.circuit.json -f kicad_sch -o "$PWD/kicad/quad.kicad_sch" && bun scripts/kicad.ts
scripts.img: tsci export dist/circuit.json -f pcb-png -o "$PWD/img/pcb.png" && tsci export dist/sch.circuit.json -f schematic-svg -o "$PWD/img/schematic.svg" && bun scripts/svg.ts
